item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the dry northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend and early next week. It will be windy and cool over the region. The monsoon will moderate slightly midweek next week, fine weather will persist over southern China. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 25/02 (Saturday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly fine and dry. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 40 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low
